activation.note: New sites include accessible, section-level entrance motion. Core analytics collect only after consent. Push only delivers on devices where the user enables it. No shared storage, keys or external providers.

scroll-3d.use: The user explicitly requests an interactive 3D scroll section. Enable the section library entry and place it on the requested page.

club-management.use: The brief asks for private club accounts, team administration, training, internal news or shared calendars.

coach-studio.use: The user explicitly asks for tactical animation or Coach Studio. Independent of the club module.

social-studio.use: Designing posts, carousels or reels in the CMS is part of the brief.

ai-assistant.use: The user asks for generative assistance; production requires its own configured provider.

social-publishing.use: The brief asks to schedule or publish to external accounts; account/queue activation is a separate operation.

newsletter.use: The brief asks to collect subscribers or send newsletters. Requires a dedicated SMTP setup for live delivery.

blog.use: The brief requests ongoing editorial posts. Editorial profiles start with a blog; its public visibility can be changed independently in the CMS.

document-studio.use: The project needs its own branded documents or editable emails. Enable sending and private storage separately according to the workflow.

commerce.use: Checkout, payments or order handling is explicitly requested.

invoicing.use: A standalone finance or invoicing workflow is explicitly requested. Commerce receipts are a separate feature.

creator.use: The user requests a creator profile/media kit and associated creator-specific tools.

mcp-agent-access.use: The user requests an external agent or private HTTP MCP client.

project-proposals.use: Inquiry follow-up needs versioned offers or appointment proposals and approval links.

booking.use: A real booking or calendar workflow is requested.

portal-crm.use: The brief needs a customer CRM or portal beyond the independent club module.

podcast.use: The brief requires a podcast site or feed.

reviews.use: The project asks to show authentic reviews from an owned profile or authorized source.

print-studio.use: The project asks for a print workflow or editable business cards.

restaurant-menu.use: The brief asks for a food, drinks or venue menu. Reuse the central data in one or more placed sections.

reservations.use: The brief asks to receive table reservations. Set up and verify actual capacity, windows, closures and the reply workflow before launch.

liquid-glass.use: The brief explicitly chooses an iOS-like Liquid Glass direction with visual depth. Existing profiles and default designs stay unchanged. No fixed brand assets, planets, credentials or external services.
